info.name: E-Commerce Smoke
info.description: QA smoke suite ported from qa/bruno. Self-contained polling — runnable in Postman desktop Runner, Newman CLI, and the Postman MCP. See qa/postman/README.md (human) and qa/postman/AGENT.md (AI QA agent).

item.name: 00 Health
item.description: GET /health/ready on every published service port. Order matches the CI smoke wait order (auth → resources → gateway), with saga at the end.
